primitives.note: Tailwind converts Janna's bonus movement speed into bonus magic damage on basic attacks (on-hit) and on Zephyr's damage instance (30% of bonus MS).
Tailwind adds bonus magic damage to every basic attack against the dummy.
Howling Gale is cast to charge, then manually or automatically recast to launch the whirlwind and deal its magic damage/knockup; cooldown starts on the initial cast.
Zephyr deals its magic damage directly on hit after a 0.245s cast time and travel.
Eye of the Storm grants bonus AD to the shielded target (Janna herself in the damage fight) for as long as the 4s shield holds.
Eye of the Storm's own cooldown is refunded 20% when a Janna ability slows or knocks up an enemy champion (once per cast), increasing E uptime and thus AD-buff uptime.
Mana costs (90-110 Q, 50-70 W, 70-90 E, 100 R) can meaningfully limit how many casts fit in the 15s window depending on mana pool/regen assumed.
Eye of the Storm's shield (damage absorb) and Monsoon's channelled heal are defensive effects read only in the survival fight, not the damage fight.

needsBespoke.why: Howling Gale's damage scales continuously with elapsed charge time (0 to 3s, both min-damage base and a per-second bonus-damage term keyed to seconds charged) before the player chooses to recast it. None of the closed-list primitives cleanly express a continuous, player-controlled charge-duration-to-damage ramp that also doesn't block other actions while charging (it isn't a channel that locks out attacking/casting, and it isn't a fixed-step recast/multipart or a per-cast stack); the simulator needs bespoke logic to pick a charge time and compute the resulting minimum+bonus damage before the launch.

unsettled.question: Is Howling Gale's charge-scaling damage continuous with exact elapsed seconds, or does it step up only at whole-second increments (0/1/2/3s) as the description implies ('increasing... every second')?
options: Continuous: damage = MinDamage + BonusDamage x (exact seconds charged, e.g. 1.5) + AP terms
Discrete: damage only increases at the 1s, 2s, 3s marks, so charging 1.5s yields the same bonus as charging 1.0s
quotes: increasing its range, speed, damage, and knock up duration every second over the duration.

unsettled.question: Does Tailwind's 'bonus movement speed' input (which converts to bonus magic damage on attacks and Zephyr) include movement speed granted by Zephyr's own passive buff, creating a self-referential MS-to-damage stack, or only MS from items/base kit outside Zephyr?
options: Includes all current bonus MS, including Zephyr's own passive bonus MS
Excludes Zephyr's own passive MS (only counts MS from other sources such as boots/runes)
quotes: deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{as|30% of her '''bonus''' movement speed}}

unsettled.question: In the survival fight, does taking damage from the attacking champion interrupt Monsoon's healing channel, or does only Janna's own actions (attack/cast/move/most items) interrupt it as the interaction table states?
options: Only Janna's own listed actions interrupt the channel; incoming damage does not stop the heal
Being attacked/damaged also interrupts the channel like a standard channelled ability

proposal: Open by casting Eye of the Storm on herself to gain the bonus AD buff before attacking.

Cast Howling Gale, then recast it promptly (minimizing charge time) so its magic damage instance lands early and its 14s cooldown starts as soon as possible, leaving room for a second cast later in the fight if time allows.
Cast Zephyr on the dummy for its direct magic damage plus Tailwind's bonus-MS-derived magic damage, on cooldown throughout the fight.
Auto-attack the dummy continuously between ability casts and during Howling Gale's charge window to benefit from Tailwind's on-hit magic damage bonus and Eye of the Storm's AD buff.
Recast Eye of the Storm on herself whenever it is off cooldown to maintain the AD buff uptime.
Do not cast Monsoon; it deals no damage to the dummy and its heal is irrelevant in the damage-only fight.
questions: Should Howling Gale be charged partway (e.g. to 1-3s) for higher per-cast damage at the cost of delaying its single hit within the 15s window, or is an instant recast always better for total damage/kill time?

Does Eye of the Storm's cooldown-refund-on-CC ever trigger in the damage fight (i.e., does Howling Gale's knockup or Zephyr's slow count as landing on the target dummy), increasing E's uptime beyond its base cooldown?
Is there a minimum charge time before Howling Gale can be manually recast, or can it be recast at effectively 0s charge immediately after the initial cast?
For the survival fight, should Monsoon be held until low health to maximize survival, and does the heal's value in the closed-list model rely on the channel-interruption ruling above?
